subject: SOC 2 Type II coverage clarification + procurement evidence timeline
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@medscale.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@medscale.com, ITSec Team <itsec@medscale.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal timeline

Hi Camila,

We're preparing the procurement packet for our upcoming renewal (target renewal date: 2027-01-15) and need to confirm Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II coverage and whether you can provide a bridge letter while the next audit is in progress. Specifically:

- Can you provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report (audit period covered)?
- Will Redwood issue a bridge letter that covers the gap between the report date and our contract renewal? If so, what dates will it cover and when can we expect it?
- Our procurement checklist (attached) asks for evidence on user access reviews, incidence response summaries, encryption-at-rest/in-transit details, and subprocessor roster — can you confirm availability and an expected delivery date for those items?

We have an internal deadline to circulate materials to finance/legal by 2026-11-22, so any documentation by mid-November would be ideal.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Senior Procurement Manager
MedScale Health

Attachments: Procurement_Checklist_MedScale.xlsx
From: camila_reyes@redwood.example
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@medscale.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example, karthik_iyer@redwood.example, dev_patel@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal timeline

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear checklist. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter that will cover the audit gap; we can also surface the items you listed via our evidence portal.

Plan I propose:
- We will send the redacted SOC 2 Type II report (latest) and a draft bridge letter by 2026-11-12.
- We will share a secure evidence package link (access-controlled) with the items requested (user access review samples, IR summary, encryption controls doc, subprocessor list) by 2026-11-16.
- If you need answers inline on the procurement checklist, we can return a completed copy by 2026-11-19.

I've looped in Neha (Security) to validate the evidence package and Karhtik (Solutions) for any technical clarifications. Dev is on copy for procurement/legal handoff and DocuSign timing. If this timeline works for MedScale, we'll commit to it and begin preparing deliverables.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: -
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.example
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@medscale.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.example
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal timeline

Hi Emily, Camila — Neha here from Security. Quick context on coverage: our last Type II report covers the period 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 (report issued 2025-11-15). We're scheduled for our next audit in Q2 2026 with a report expected in late Q3 2026; however, given MedScale's renewal timing, we will provide a formal bridge letter that states the audit period covered and the controls' status through 2026-06-30.

Deliverables and notes:
- SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025.pdf (redacted) — attached for your review.
- SOC2_Bridge_Letter_2026-06-30.pdf (draft) — will be provided by 2026-11-12. Bridge will explicitly state: "Redwood Inference's SOC 2 Type II report covers 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30; Redwood confirms no material changes to the control environment through 2026-06-30 and will provide the next Type II report upon issuance."
- Evidence portal: we will provision a read-only folder in the secure evidence portal with sample artifacts: access review export (redacted), incident response timeline (summaries), encryption architecture diagram and key handling overview, and a current subprocessor roster. Access will be granted to emily.zhang@medscale.com and itsec@medscale.com.

A couple of caveats:
- Certain artifacts (full incident tickets, raw logs) are redacted for customer privacy — we provide summarized evidence and root cause documentation.
- For compliance with our policy, bridge letters are signed by our Head of Security and limited to 9 months beyond the last report; the language above is standard.

If you want, Karhtik can give a 20-min walkthrough of the encryption and network segmentation controls next week — that can help your security reviewers.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025.pdf
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@medscale.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.example, neha_kapoor@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@medscale.com, ITSec Team <itsec@medscale.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal timeline

Thanks Camila/Neha — that plan looks good. Two clarifying items from our side:

1) The procurement team needs the bridge letter to explicitly state the end date it covers and who signs it (job title fine).
2) For our audit team, a short statement about any control changes (major infra migrations, new subprocessors in the last 12 months) would be helpful.

Also, can you confirm whether providing the evidence portal link requires any special NDA addendum? If not, we will circulate to Finance/Legal for their 11/22 review.

Appreciate the offer for the walkthrough — yes please, a 20-min session with Karhtik would be helpful.

Best,
Emily
From: camila_reyes@redwood.example
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@medscale.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example, karthik_iyer@redwood.example, dev_patel@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal timeline

Emily — quick status update and mutual action plan (MAP):

MAP milestones:
- By 2026-11-12: Deliver redacted SOC 2 Type II report (attached) and signed bridge letter (PDF).
- By 2026-11-16: Share evidence portal link with requested artifacts (read-only, expiring access).
- 2026-11-18 or 2026-11-19: 20-min technical walkthrough with Karhtik (please propose preferred time).
- By 2026-11-19: Return completed procurement checklist to MedScale.
- By 2026-12-20: Target contract signature to ensure coverage before 2027-01-15 renewal.

On the NDA question: no additional NDA addendum is required to access the portal; access will be governed by standard Redwoods evidence sharing terms (view-only links, access logging, and per-user MFA). I'll have Dev confirm DocuSign envelope timing once you confirm the target signature date.

If this MAP looks good, we'll proceed and I'll send the bridge and report now.

Thanks,
Camila

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Report_2025.pdf, SOC2_Bridge_Letter_2026-06-30.pdf
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@medscale.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.example
Cc: procurement@medscale.com, ITSec Team <itsec@medscale.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + bridge for renewal timeline

Camila — MAP confirmed. We'll schedule the walkthrough for 2026-11-19 at 10:00am PT (Karhtik, please confirm). Procurement will await the bridge and evidence link; if anything slips, please flag earliest.

Thanks,
Emily
